shared_elements: standing human figure, frontal, with arms out from body
justification: The only correspondence is the near-universal motif of an upright human figure with arms held away from the body, and in both cases a figure grasping some object. Otherwise the content is unrelated: A is a single, densely detailed, elaborately costumed and ornamented figure filling the whole field, while B is a sparse multi-figure scene of minimally schematic stick-and-silhouette people, weapons, circular forms and a large profile quadruped ridden by a standing man.
